instruction: The first phone received a Simple SMS Messenger message asking me to find a specific photo in Downloads on the second phone. Use Android Files on the second phone to check for it. If the photo is missing, create a Markor note called `Photo status` on the second phone with the missing filename and Simple SMS Messenger as the source.

variables.sms_body: Please find photo site_panel.jpg in Download.

command: content query --uri content://sms/inbox --projection address:body | grep -F '5550503' | grep -F 'site_panel.jpg' >/dev/null

mkdir -p /storage/emulated/0/Documents/Markor /storage/emulated/0/Download && rm -f '/storage/emulated/0/Documents/Markor/Photo status.md' /storage/emulated/0/Download/site_panel.jpg && test ! -e /storage/emulated/0/Download/site_panel.jpg && test ! -e '/storage/emulated/0/Documents/Markor/Photo status.md'

metadata.surfaces: android_0 Simple SMS Messenger -> android_1 Android Files app 的 Download 文件夹/Markor
metadata.setup_note: android_0 注入并校验 photo request SMS；android_1 准备 Markor/Download，并校验目标照片和旧状态 note 均不存在。
metadata.evaluate_note: Scores the exact filename-bound missing relation and Simple SMS Messenger source in the android_1 Markor note. The note filename supplies its Photo status identity; the body need not repeat that title. Target-file absence remains a diagnostic-only source-integrity check and does not add an undisclosed preservation requirement.
metadata.lite_evaluator_hardening_note: The scored note parser uses extension-aware filename boundaries and binds the exact requested filename to one unambiguous affirmative missing relation without imposing an undisclosed body-title line. Questions, uncertainty, contracted/no-longer/never contradictions, and duplicate or mixed sources fail. One unique source declaration may naturally use Source punctuation, Source is, Requested via, or from. The target-file absence evaluator is diagnostic-only.
